notes.title: 🛠️ Cyber Evolution – Devlog #3
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’re back — and a few days early this time! This update brings some [b]major new systems[/b], a bunch of [b]fresh evolutions[/b], and several [b]new maps[/b] to shake things up. Let’s get into it.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌟 Introducing: Prime Evolutions[/h3][p]The [b]biggest addition[/b] in this update is the first pass of our [b]Prime Evolution[/b] system![/p][p]Prime Evolutions are [b]selected only in the first round[/b] and set the tone for your entire match. Think of them as your core combat identity for the run.[/p][p]Here’s what’s currently available:[/p][list][*][p][b]Mono-Core[/b]
A single, high-damage shot to start your run strong and precise.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Thermal Overdrive (New)[/b]
Machine-gun-like firing with rapid shots, low damage, and an overheat risk if you hold down the trigger too long.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590290/9d548f7ff199b57ec7f253a62793bf74e50651b8.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Shotgun[/b]
The classic close-range burst returns — now reworked into a Prime Evolution slot.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Plasma Condenser (New)[/b]
Charge your weapon using [b]all available heat[/b] for a massive projectile. More heat = more damage and size.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590290/f76550cc1ee010acc0db58522751fadb1524db3a.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]More Prime Evolutions are already in the works and will roll out in the next update![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧬 New Evolutions[/h3][list][*][p][b]Energy Shell Burst[/b] – Convert your shield into a short-range explosion that can [b]shock[/b] enemies.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590290/5f98d33548d8771f108b9f5fd827a640722d9b75.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Servos[/b] – A straightforward [b]movement speed[/b] boost.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kinetic Absorption[/b] – Gain a [b]speed burst[/b] when you take damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heat Sink Array[/b] – [b]Increases your heat capacity[/b], allowing for longer fire windows.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Plasma Fragmentation[/b] – Adds [b]more projectiles to Shotgun[/b] blasts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]D7 Spread Enhancer[/b] – [b]Tightens spread[/b] for more focused Shotgun damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Momentum Core[/b] – Projectiles [b]grow in size and damage[/b] the farther they travel.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🗺️ New Maps[/h3][p]You asked for more maps — and we delivered![/p][list][*][p][b]Cyber City[/b] [i](formerly Mega City)[/i]
A massive, multi-zone map containing four regions: [b]Warehouse[/b], [b]Downtown[/b], [b]Power Plant[/b], and [b]Residential[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590290/dd0310a2a04bec5b6f0d78f06ee675f2901a3615.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Biolab[/b]
A [b]tight, vertical map[/b] where players spawn underneath and use a launch tube to jump into the fight.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590290/060174e4a46ffc4402065988d5f046d3f78de254.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bounce House[/b]
A [b]medium-sized arena[/b] packed with launch pads for wild angles and chaotic plays.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590290/1e64d38797305518f5754bbca2923929e4495c63.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Containment[/b]
A [b]close-quarters map[/b] featuring tight container corridors and a single-exit spawn room you’ll need to figure your way out of.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590290/cab641aa67b84817b702d2cccfbac1636da11140.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐛 Backend Fight Continues[/h3][p]We’ve been hammering on some stubborn bugs — especially the one that caused players to get stuck on the [b]“Waiting for players to load”[/b] screen.[/p][p]Good news: in internal testing, it only happened [b]once across several hours of gameplay[/b]. The fix primarily helps players with [b]higher ping[/b], but we’ll keep pushing until it's 100% gone.[/p][p]Also, a few evolutions received [b]backend changes[/b] to align with newer systems — they should still feel the same during gameplay.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧭 What’s Next?[/h3][p]Here’s a sneak peek at what we’re working on for the next update:[/p][list][*][p][b]More Prime Evolutions[/b] — we’ve got some surprises coming.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI for Prime Evolutions[/b] — so you’ll know exactly what you’re picking and how it works.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More Maps[/b] — we’re closing in on the [b]20 map[/b] milestone.[/p][/*][*][p]Continuing polish as we [b]move closer to Beta[/b] status.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks again for playing, sharing feedback, and helping us build something awesome. Join our [url="https://discord.gg/twhYftdWDg"]Discord[/url] for full patch notes and community play sessions![/p][p]See you in the arena,
— Kemlage 💾[/p]

notes.title: Bi-Weekly(ish) Devlog #2 – New Maps, Overhauls, and Evolutions!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’re back — a little late this time (we’re calling it [i]bi-weekly-ish[/i]), but we’ve got a solid batch of updates that we think you’ll enjoy. Let’s jump into what’s new![/p][hr][/hr][h3]💻 UI Overhaul Progress[/h3][p]The transition to [b]Common UI[/b] is nearly complete on the backend! Most of the heavy lifting is done, and the system is much more scalable and stable. Some new animations and sound effects are already in — especially on the profile select screen — and you can expect art updates as we inch closer to our planned Q4 launch. This is a foundational change, so we’ll be iterating on the visuals over time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590290/680084c469450bc99a69c5e5c5b6e071131606ac.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔄 Round Start Fixes[/h3][p]We’ve put a lot of work into improving round starts. There were a few pesky bugs causing desync or inconsistent timing when rounds began. While we’re still chasing down a few edge cases, the experience is now noticeably more stable and snappy across the board.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💥 Damage System Overhaul[/h3][p]We’ve reworked the [b]damage application system[/b] to make it faster and more reliable. This also laid the groundwork for better balance control — several evolutions have been re-tuned to work with the new system. You’ll feel the difference in responsiveness during fights.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🗺️ New Maps[/h3][p]We’ve added [b]two new maps[/b] to shake things up:[/p][list][*][p][b]Pillars[/b]
A tight, close-quarters map filled with pillars that break sightlines and create some really creative combat angles. There’s also a launch pad in the central building that lets you reach a second level — high ground fans, rejoice.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590290/90253573203aeba75d57e6de6bd87625ff03bd32.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Drop Zone[/b] [i](Work in Progress)[/i]
A chaotic battlefield with a missing center floor. Instead, you’ve got a few sketchy platforms — which fall at random when someone lands on them. Adds a big risk-reward twist with the chance to fall to your doom. It’s wild, and we’re still fine-tuning it.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590290/6e8b6b55caa0233defc02a505ac3b97fea00fb7d.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧬 New Evolution[/h3][list][*][p][b]Quantum Step[/b] [i](Work in Progress)[/i]
This one lets you [b]teleport forward[/b] to a location within your line of sight. It stacks, too — so you can jump even further if you double down on it. Still squashing some bugs with it, but it’s already a blast to test.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 Evolution Reworks[/h3][list][*][p][b]Homing[/b]
Major backend tweaks allow stacking this now — but as a result, it’s a bit weaker for the moment. We’ll be tuning it back up soon to bring it closer to its original strength.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Glass Reactor[/b]
Significantly reduced scaling — it was a little [i]too[/i] strong under the new system. Also now lowers your health more to keep things spicy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Incendiary Core[/b]
Now scales with the damage being dealt — a more natural fit for burn builds and damage-over-time synergy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sticky Charge Core[/b]
Got a full rework on visuals and audio! Plus, its [b]explosion radius[/b] now matches the effect (and it's bigger).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐛 Bug Fixes & Discord Notes[/h3][p]There were a bunch of smaller bug fixes that aren’t listed here — if you want the full nitty gritty patch notes, head over to our Discord where we post everything as it hits.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ What’s Next?[/h3][list][*][p][b]Mega City Map[/b] is still in the works — it's big, bold, and a bit tricky, but we’re making steady progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller support[/b] got bumped down the priority list while we crushed bugs, but it’s still coming.[/p][/*][*][p]Expect [b]1-2 new maps[/b] in the next post.[/p][/*][*][p]And we’re planning to drop [b]3–5 new evolutions[/b] over the next two weeks![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]As always, thanks for playing and testing with us — your feedback’s been huge in helping us shape Cyber Evolution into something great. More to come soon![/p][p]— Kemlage[/p]

notes.title: Cyber Evolution — Dev Update #1: Welcome to the Bi-Weekly Recap!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to the [b]first official bi-weekly devlog[/b] for [i]Cyber Evolution[/i]![/h1]
We’re laying the foundation for a smoother, more responsive game — from reworked UI to refined combat and early controller support.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🔫 Shooting & Overheat Updates[/h2]

Combat is starting to feel much tighter and more satisfying.

[list]
[*][b]Projectile visuals[/b] have been updated, with new sounds to match  
[*][b]Impact effects[/b] now look and sound more impactful  
[*][b]New animations[/b] for both shooting and overheating help sell the action  
[*][b]Overheat visuals[/b] give clearer feedback on buildup and cooldown  
[/list]

We also made [b]timing and base speed adjustments[/b] to better sync visuals and gameplay. The improvements have added a real punch and clarity.

We’re still tuning sound attenuation to avoid overwhelming audio in chaotic moments, but we’re thrilled with how it’s coming together.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🎮 Controller Support Progress[/h2]

Our first step toward full controller support is in!

[list]
[*][b]Movement, aiming, and shooting[/b] are functional using an Xbox One controller  
[*][b]Main menu navigation[/b] is mostly working  
[*][b]Other menus and combat features[/b] like dash and shield are still in development  
[/list]

Only Xbox controllers have been tested so far, but we’re planning full support — including [b]custom keybinding and rebinding systems[/b] down the road.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🧩 UI Improvements & Common UI Migration[/h2]

A total visual refresh is underway.

[list]
[*]The UI has been [b]completely rebuilt visually[/b] to better match the style and colors of the [i]Cyber Evolution[/i] brand  
[*]We’ve migrated to Unreal’s [b]Common UI subsystem[/b] for better consistency, scalability, and input handling  
[*][b]Previous menus[/b] have been updated; the [b]gameplay HUD[/b] is in progress  
[*][b]Loading and transition screens[/b] are on deck next  
[/list]

This is a huge step forward in streamlining our interface. Once everything’s migrated, we’ll begin adding [b]new sound effects and UI animations[/b] to finish the transformation.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🔮 What’s Next?[/h2]

In the next two weeks, we’re aiming to:

[list]
[*]Finish migrating the [b]remaining UI elements[/b] to Common UI  
[*]Add [b]new SFX[/b] to the interface for improved feedback  
[*]Continue refining controller input across menus and gameplay  
[*]Expand our [b]evolution system[/b] — we currently have [b]22 evolutions[/b] and more in the pipeline!  
[/list]

And as a teaser… we’ve begun early work on a new [b]Mega City map[/b] — a massive urban battlefield where you’ll fight in distinct sections round by round, with full visibility across the entire city as the action unfolds.

[i]👀 We’ll be sharing some clips of UI testing and early city layout soon.[/i]

[hr][/hr]

Thanks for being part of the journey from the very beginning.  
Your support means everything, and we can’t wait to show you what’s coming next.


[b]FCG_Kemlage – Final Chapter Games[/b]
